name: Why should I consider hiring a general contractor for move-out repairs instead of separate handymen?

mainEntity.name: Why should I consider hiring a general contractor for move-out repairs instead of separate handymen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor for move-out repairs offers several advantages over coordinating multiple handymen. A general contractor can manage various trades—such as painting, drywall, and minor plumbing—under one contract, streamlining communication and scheduling. This integrated approach saves you time and stress, ensuring all repairs are completed efficiently and to a consistent standard. They also oversee project quality and timelines, providing a single point of contact for complex or multi-faceted repair needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor streamlines complex move-out repairs by managing multiple trades under one contract, saving you time and ensuring consistent quality and efficient project completion.
